title: ‘It’s not clear Trump even READ the Memorandum of Understanding he signed with Iran.’
text:
‘It’s not clear Trump even READ the Memorandum of Understanding he signed with Iran.’"

"—Doug Bandow, former Special Assistant to President Reagan"

"‘The Iranians do have to be careful not to overreach. They hold the Strait. That gives them enormous leverage, but they need to be prepared to make a deal when they can."

"I think what they were worried about here was that it was pretty clear Trump was violating the MOU in terms of the Strait as well as the issue of Lebanon."

"Now, it's not clear that he actually read the MOU before he signed it. Did he actually know what was in it? It was somewhat ambiguous."

"You send over a couple of real estate developers, a childhood friend and your son-in-law and expect them to work out negotiations with Iran? What could possibly go wrong?"

"The point is that I think he realised he was in trouble, he got a lot of flak for it and thought that he could force the Iranians to back down."

"They are holding firm. I think the danger here is they have to be prepared at some point, I think, to make a deal."

"And the question then is, how do you communicate that to Trump while indicating he's got to make the real concessions…"

"but that they're willing to let him, in a sense, get away with some of his victory claims at home, as long as they get the substantive wins in the Middle East?’"
